method: 24 balanced paired rounds per state and fixture; frozen HTTPS loopback replay; two warm gates; uninstrumented scoring; interpolated p95, no p99 claim; RSS from time -l. Parent and candidate differ also in regular-file decoder routing; writers-off isolates that from worker enablement.
limitations: Independent package file bytes and executable bits checked in preflight; scored samples check inventory and LPM lock against preflight. Empty directories, node_modules directories and non-executable permission bits excluded from payload fingerprint.
Exported timeline fields omit writer_count. Final-source default and sanitized environment establish requested count2; pool spans establish attempted pool starts, not completed jobs or thread counts.
Frozen loopback replay measures local pipeline performance with warm OS caches. It does not establish live registry p95 or p99.
